snippet.title: Dungeons and Dining Tables Official Gameplay Trailer | The ANZ Indie Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Dungeons and Dining Tables sees you delve dungeons to collect rare furniture, take that furniture back to your home to decorate. The cosier your house is, the higher your stats! 

Check out the Kickstarter for Dungeons and Dining Tables now!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dndt-by-catalyst/dungeons-and-dining-tables-action-rpg-cozy-sim

Check out Dungeons and Dining Tables here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2941630/Dungeons_and_Dining_Tables/
